gloss: tip of the nose; right under one's nose

definitions.explanation: The end of the nose, of a person or an animal.

definitions.gloss: right in front of one's face; right under one's nose
definitions.explanation: The space immediately in front of someone, very close by. Used for things thrust or shut in someone's face, or done in full view of them.

examples.japanese: {鼻先|はなさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧。
examples.english: The tip of my nose is cold.
The dog pushed the door with the tip of its nose.

examples.english: On the cold morning, children with red-tipped noses were heading to school.

examples.english: The door was shut in my face.
